def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    best = (0, None)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] == 0:
                continue
            c = grid[i][j]
            s = 1
            while i + s <= h and j + s <= w and all(grid[a][b] == c for a in range(i, i+s) for b in range(j, j+s)):
                s += 1
            s -= 1
            if s > best[0]:
                best = (s, c)
    s, c = best
    side = (s + 1) // 2  # or s-2; remove one-cell border
    return [[c]*side for _ in range(side)]
''')
